# Inactive homelab workflow snapshots

These 45 workflows and their dependency lists were copied from the home
repository. They are reference material, not executable agent-setup CI.
GitHub Actions discovers workflows only in `.github/workflows/`.

Relative reusable-workflow and script paths retain their original meaning and
may not resolve here. Do not run these snapshots or move them back wholesale.
The live homelab source is [Josh-Archer/home](https://github.com/Josh-Archer/home).

Agent-setup CI ownership and validation are documented in
[docs/ci-ownership.md](../../docs/ci-ownership.md).
